title: Control flags X18b: one named marker list is the only EVOLVE_/BRIDGE_ source in a cell, plus an AST guard on env reads
summary: buildCycleEnv copies every EVOLVE_* of the operator shell into the cycle env (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_args.go:341-352). X2 (#1122, merged at stage shadow) passes only its bridge list pipelineEnvMarkers to an LLM child at enforce, but the cycle env still carries every knob and bypass (research F5.5), and the list is local to the bridge. The 32 markers are listed in docs/architecture/control-flags.md class (a). Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §27 step 2; ADR-0156 rules 11 and 15.
fix: Grow pipelineEnvMarkers of X2 into one marker list as Go data (for example ipcenv.Markers()). buildCycleEnv and the bridge cell env copy only these names. Add TestNoControlFlagReadOutsideTheMarkerList: walk each non-test Go file, find os.Getenv, os.LookupEnv and envchain reads, resolve constant concatenations, and allow only the marker list, the shrinking list of knobs not yet moved and the outside list (HOME, PATH, TMUX, CI, CLAUDE_CODE_*). Extend matrix row N1 with EVOLVE_SANDBOX and EVOLVE_BYPASS_SHIP_GATE.
acceptance: RED first: EVOLVE_BYPASS_SHIP_GATE set on the parent reaches the cycle env of buildCycleEnv today
Matrix row N1 with EVOLVE_SANDBOX and EVOLVE_BYPASS_SHIP_GATE on the parent passes at enforce
TestNoControlFlagReadOutsideTheMarkerList fails on a new os.Getenv("EVOLVE_"+"X") read in a fixture file
Changed functions at 100% coverage; control-flags.md class (a), spec §6 and §27 updated
